access_intro: This bot is invite-only. Request access and the owner will review it.
access_new: Your request was sent to the owner. I will let you know when it is reviewed.
access_pending: Your request is already being reviewed.
access_denied: Access was not approved. Contact the bot owner if you think this is an error.
access_approved: Access is already approved. Send /start to begin.
access_already_handled: This request has already been handled.
access_granted_user: The owner approved access. Send /start to begin.
access_denied_user: The owner declined your access request.
welcome: ID: {user_id} · Personal access MFD.ddmedia downloads public video and audio by link. What the bot can do Download individual videos and audio from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, VK, X, Facebook, SoundCloud, Mixcloud, Yandex Music and other supported sites. Show available quality and approximate size, extract audio as M4A or MP3, and provide a temporary file link for two hours. In groups, use /dd followed by a link. How to use Send a media link, choose a format and wait for the file.
yandex_metadata_error: Could not get Yandex Music data. The source or current downloader version returned an error; details are in the server log. Please try again later.
yandex_unavailable: Yandex Music is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
spotify_unavailable: Spotify links are recognized, but direct downloads of most tracks and podcasts are unavailable due to source restrictions. Send a public file link or a post from a supported service instead.
settings: Settings Auto download: send a small file immediately when only one suitable video format exists. Apple compatibility: convert incompatible video to H.264/AAC MP4. Caption: hide the title, metadata or description. An expandable description can be used when the description fits in a Telegram caption. The RichMessage and gallery slideshow modes from the example are not available in this bot. On = enabled · Off = disabled
files_retention: Download links last two hours; file history stays for 30 days.
clear_confirm: Delete your stored files and revoke download links?
clip_choose_format: Choose video quality for the clip:
clip_enter_range: Send the start and end time in this format: 00:30–01:45. Maximum length: {max_minutes} minutes.
clip_bad_range: I could not read that time range. Try 00:30–01:45. The end must be after the start and the clip cannot exceed 10 minutes.
clip_exceeds_duration: The clip end is past the video duration ({duration} sec). Send another range or type “Cancel”.
clip_source_expired: This video card is no longer available. Send the link again.
clip_queued: Clip added to the queue: position {position}.
queue_full: The queue is full. Please try again later.
audio_edit_enter_range: Enter start and end, for example 00:10–01:20 (up to 10 minutes), or “whole”.
admin_ram: RAM: {free} GB free; {available} GB available of {total} GB
bug_need_image: Send a screenshot as a photo or PNG/JPG file. Include #bugreport and a description in its caption.
bug_need_description: Add a description to the screenshot caption along with #bugreport.
bug_image_too_large: The screenshot exceeds 20 MB. Send a smaller file.
bug_save_failed: Could not save the ticket and screenshot. Please send the message again.
bug_list_empty: There are no tickets in this section.
admin_yandex_status_connected: Connected. The token is stored in a protected server configuration file.
admin_yandex_status_disconnected: Not connected. No token for a Yandex Plus account was found.
admin_yandex_instructions: Press the button below. I will send you a sign-in link and a one-time code in a private message. Open the link and sign in to an account with Yandex Plus. The bot will not display the token.
admin_yandex_already_running: Authorization is already running. Check your private messages.
admin_yandex_starting: Starting Yandex Music authorization. I will send the link and code in a separate message.
admin_yandex_dm: Connect Yandex Music Open: {url} One-time code: {code} Sign in to an account with Yandex Plus. Do not share this code.
admin_yandex_auth_success: Yandex Music is connected. New requests will use the updated token.
admin_yandex_failed: Could not connect Yandex Music. Check the code and account access, then try again with /admin.
admin_stats_users: Unique users who messaged the bot: {count}
admin_online_unknown: Telegram does not provide the bot with online presence information.
admin_history_choose: History by user. Choose a user:
admin_files_by_date: 📁 Downloaded files by date (UTC). Files and links are kept for 2 hours.
admin_clean_prompt: Delete the bot's temporary download folders on the server ({folders}) to free up space? They currently use about {size}. Temporary links will stop working. Files already sent to Telegram will remain in the chat.
admin_clean_busy: Wait for the current task to finish or cancel it first.
admin_clean_failed: Could not fully clean the folders. Check server permissions and disk space.
admin_clean_done: Removed temporary folders: {folders}. Disk space freed: {freed}. Temporary links revoked: {links}.
